items.title: Anthropic study: Claude Code's hidden leanings steered expert analysts 86% of the time
items.summary: In a randomized Anthropic trial, 50 experienced analysts working with Claude Code matched the agent's secretly randomized preferences on judgment calls 86% of the time, often repeating its arguments while believing they had decided independently, even as the agent cut errors and sped up work.

items.title: Judgment Labs opens its AI agent monitoring platform to everyone
items.summary: Judgment Labs made its agent monitoring platform generally available: it captures full execution traces from long-running agents, runs customisable judges over them and uses a built-in agent to surface failure patterns, alerts and tests. The $32M-backed startup already counts Fluidstack and Modal as customers.

OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper, faster model for computer-use agents
items.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra targets visual reasoning and precise computer use at API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra; it is live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for paid plans and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra, with OpenAI reporting more than double its predecessor's Terminal-Bench 4.0 score.

items.title: Anthropic publicly files its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under the ticker ANT
items.summary: Anthropic's registration statement for a proposed Class A share offering is now public, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading; share count and price range have not been set, and the filing gives agent builders a first audited look at the economics behind Claude.

items.title: Oracle launches Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home at Oracle AI World
items.summary: At Oracle AI World in Las Vegas, Oracle introduced Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home so employees can trigger multi-step workflows across finance, HR, supply chain, sales and service in plain language.

items.title: Theo open-sources tstack, a set of practical skills for Claude Code and Codex
items.summary: Developer Theo released tstack on GitHub, a bundle of agent skills for Claude Code and Codex. Highlights include full-send, which pushes a change all the way to a merged pull request, and council, which gathers reviews from several models.
